notes:
- Transaction detail page redesigned: a clear summary with the amount, a two-column details grid, the documents a payment closed (with installment and due date), transfer "from → to", accrual progress, and a record panel with who created / changed it and its history; actions that cannot be used are no longer shown
- Lists and open screens refresh by themselves after any save or delete (for example a new account appears at once in the referral field, and a deleted category's account leaves the chart of accounts)
- Category and payment type choices are grouped: the main category is a bold heading and sub-categories are listed by their own name, so typing finds them
- Transaction category is required on new accruals and opening balances
- Assets: the standard details are required (vehicle: plate, brand, model, year; building: address, city, area; land: address, city, parcel, area; equipment: brand, model)
- Unused sub-categories created by the system can be deleted; main groups and asset categories stay
- This update is for Windows; the macOS and Linux versions stay on their current version
